title: tactustherapy - Videos
description:
Tactus Therapy puts speech therapy in your hands. Through interactive and evidence-based software and apps, adults and the speech-language pathologists who serve them have access to quality therapy exercises and techniques for speech, language, cognitive, and swallowing rehabilitation. Stroke survivors and their families enjoy access to customizable practice, while SLPs appreciate the flexibility and professional reports of our software. We also pride ourselves on providing high-quality resources to support speech therapy. Check out our videos, website, and newsletter to learn more about the Tactus Therapy Virtual Rehab Center for clinicians and our apps for iOS and Android devices. 

This channel will show walk-throughs of all our software and apps.
